d: Short, voluminous ash-brown hair with blunt-cut bangs and a single ahoge sprout from the top. Golden-yellow eyes with a gentle, neutral expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a white long-sleeved blouse under a sleeveless magenta jumper dress, accented by a large teal bow at the collar and dark brown lace-up boots. Signature details include a large grey mechanical ship-rigging apparatus on the back and hips, featuring cannons and a mast.
